reachability.note: HTTP 200 via curl; WebFetch blocked with 403 by Cloudflare bot protection

1.1_llms_txt.details: delphi.gensyn.ai/llms.txt returns 404. docs.delphi.gensyn.ai does not exist (ECONNREFUSED). Parent docs site docs.gensyn.ai/llms.txt does exist with full documentation index, but not on the Delphi domain itself.

1.2_markdown_negotiation.details: Accept: text/markdown header returns text/html; charset=utf-8. No markdown content negotiation.

1.3_structured_metadata.details: Rich meta tags present: meta description ('Delphi is a prediction market over model evaluations...'), og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:site_name, twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image, keywords, application-name, canonical URL. No JSON-LD.

2.1_content_without_js.details: Next.js app with empty body in raw HTML source. All content is JS-rendered. The body contains only a hidden div with React template markers and script tags. No readable text without JavaScript execution.

2.2_semantic_html.details: Rendered DOM includes 4 semantic elements: navigation (nav bar), main (content area), article (market cards), contentinfo/footer. Meets the 3+ threshold but only after JS renders.

2.3_readable_url_slugs.details: URLs are reasonably readable: /market/active, /market/9, /account. Market IDs are numeric rather than slug-based, but the structure is clear and predictable.

3.1_dev_docs_exist.details: Documentation exists at docs.gensyn.ai/intelligence-market/what-is-delphi covering what Delphi is, liquidity & pricing, trading & evaluation, rounds & winners. Additional pages for vaults and getting started.

3.2_docs_findable.details: Docs link is in the main navigation bar (1 click away), pointing to https://docs.gensyn.ai/intelligence-market/what-is-delphi. Also linked in the footer.

3.3_programmatic_surface_documented.details: No API documentation, no contract addresses, no SDK, no developer integration docs. Documentation is entirely user/consumer-facing, explaining concepts and UI workflows only.

3.4_standard_navigation.details: Standard anchor tags with href attributes throughout: nav links to /market/active, external docs, /account; market cards link to /market/{id}; footer links to gensyn.ai, dashboard, docs, Discord, X.

4.1_ai_crawlers_allowed.details: robots.txt (Cloudflare Managed) explicitly blocks AI crawlers: ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Google-Extended, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot, meta-externalagent all have Disallow: /. Content-Signal explicitly sets ai-train=no. WebFetch requests are blocked with 403.

4.2_no_captcha.details: No CAPTCHA encountered. Cloudflare is present but did not trigger a challenge for browser-based access. Curl requests succeed for the main page.

4.3_bot_policy_or_agent_docs.details: robots.txt includes Cloudflare's Content-Signal framework (search=yes, ai-train=no) with EU Directive 2019/790 rights reservation. However, no dedicated bot policy page or agent-specific documentation exists.

notes: Delphi is a Next.js SPA with Cloudflare bot protection. The site is effectively invisible to non-JS agents -- raw HTML is empty. Cloudflare's managed robots.txt blocks all major AI crawlers. Documentation lives on the parent Gensyn docs site (docs.gensyn.ai) rather than a Delphi-specific subdomain. The docs are conceptual/user-facing only with no programmatic integration surface documented. Strong metadata game (og/twitter tags) but fundamentally hostile to agent access due to JS-only rendering and aggressive bot blocking.
